error.invalid_auth: The passcode is not valid for this callsign.
error.invalid_callsign: Enter a callsign, optionally with an SSID, such as N0CALL-13.
error.invalid_callsigns: Enter one or more callsigns to track, such as N0CALL-9, or N0CALL* for every SSID.
error.invalid_symbol: Enter a symbol table character (/, \ or an overlay letter or digit) followed by the symbol code, such as /_ for a weather station.
error.weather_symbol_required: Weather data can only be sent with a weather station symbol, such as /_.

data_description.callsign: Callsign to log in to APRS-IS with.
data_description.callsigns: Stations to track. End a callsign with * to track every SSID. Weather stations are not tracked.
data_description.password: Optional; leave empty to log in receive-only.

data_description.comment: Text sent at the end of each report.
data_description.location_entity: Zone, person or device tracker whose position is reported. Moving entities report more often the faster they go, from every 30 minutes when stopped to every 3 minutes at 60 mph, and soon after turning; their course and speed are included.
data_description.position_ambiguity: Number of trailing position digits to leave out, from 0 (exact) to 4 (nearest degree).
data_description.suppress_template: Optional template; while it renders true, no reports are sent, for example near home. If it fails to render, reports are held back too.
data_description.symbol: APRS symbol table and code, such as /_ for a weather station or /- for a house.

station.description: Choose what the station reports. Reports with weather are sent every 10 minutes, position-only reports every 30 minutes.

weather.description: Sensors to report. Values are converted to APRS units; unavailable sensors are left out.
weather.name: Weather

station.title: Station

data_description.callsign: Callsign and SSID the station reports as, such as N0CALL-13.
data_description.host: APRS-IS server to send reports to.

user.description: Publish your own position and weather to APRS-IS, or track other stations' positions.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to APRS-IS server {host}.

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because Home Assistant could not connect to the APRS-IS server {host}.

Check that the server is reachable, then restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the APRS `device_tracker` configuration from your configuration.yaml file and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: The APRS YAML configuration could not be imported

yaml_import_invalid_auth.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because the APRS-IS server refused its passcode.

Fix or remove the `password` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_auth.title: The APRS YAML configuration could not be imported
